verdict.rationale: Slate is a coding agent, so git workflow automation is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions staging, commit-message generation, branch creation or pull-request opening. The only related items are user-run shell commands via `!` and generic permission controls, which are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent stage changes, write commit messages, create branches, and open pull requests
